hero_kpi_rationale: The number of franchises is a key indicator of the company's growth and financial health, as each franchise generates royalties for Winmark.

kpis.name: Number of operating franchises
kpis.description: The number of franchises is a key indicator of the company's growth and financial health.
kpis.signal: Growth in the number of franchises

kpis.name: Number of employees
kpis.explanation: Total number of Winmark Corporation employees
kpis.description: The number of employees reflects the franchise model that delegates operations to independent franchisees.
kpis.signal: Lightweight business model with low number of direct employees

risks.title: Dependence on franchise renewals
risks.score_rationale: 305 franchises are set to expire within the next three years. Failure to renew a significant number of these franchises would have a material negative impact on financial performance.

risks.title: Dependence on royalties
risks.score_rationale: Royalties represent 88.7% of the company's revenue, making it vulnerable to declines in franchise sales.

risks.title: POS system modernization risks
risks.score_rationale: POS system modernization is a complex initiative with risks of system instability, operational disruptions, and franchisee disruptions.

risks.title: Increased competition
risks.score_rationale: The retail industry is highly competitive. Franchisees face competition from new-item retailers and secondhand stores.

risks.title: Financing restrictions and covenant risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to operational and financial restrictions under its credit agreements. Covenant breaches could lead to debt acceleration.

risks.title: Dependence on supply of secondhand goods
risks.score_rationale: The business model relies on a steady supply of quality secondhand goods. This supply is unreliable and subject to regulatory constraints.
